competitors.description:
如果为各类申牌企业进行分类，运营/托管两分最为恰当：

🦀Anchorage 为代表的托管发行为主，主要卖的是美国合规市场准入权：
- 和 Tether 合作 USAT🇺🇸
- 和 Ethena 合作 USDtb
- 和西联汇款合作 USDPT，PT 是 Payment Token 简称
- 和 OSL 合作 USDGO，OSL 是香港合规交易所，已被 Bitget 控股

BitGo 是其竞争对手，与香港🇭🇰财团合作发行  FYUSD，目标也是类似 OSL 的 USDGO，盯上合规+企业级市场

🍤Circle 为代表的运营发行，主要用于自身“品牌”稳定币：
- USDC 合美国的规，主打合规市场和 B2B 业务
- EURC 合欧美的规，对比下已经撤出欧元业务的 Tether
- USYC 合收益的规，收益市场也在悄悄搞，只给机构用

Ripple/Paxos 也想走这条路，但是难度非常大，RLUSD 并无真正市场采用，Paxos 在 $BUSD 之后推出的 USDG 并不成功

至于剩下的产品线和渠道方，更主要是为了填补稳定币业务空白，方便开展加密时代资产入口业务。

clients.title: News from the Middle East has weighed heavily on us. With team members and partners in the region, t
clients.description:
News from the Middle East has weighed heavily on us. With team members and partners in the region, this is not distant news for us, it touches people we know and work with every day.

At Bitunix, we are mindful that behind every account is a real person, and behind every transaction is a life that may be facing uncertainty. We are offering full flexibility and support to colleagues in affected areas.

We also recognize our responsibility to safeguard our community’s assets and uphold the security and stability of our platform, ensuring dependable access for users and partners worldwide.

Beyond business and beyond borders, what matters most is the safety and dignity of human life. We hope for lasting peace.
